request.purpose: Test the algebraic lever rule under equal partition selectivity, identical concentrations across phases, a degenerate 0/0 case and an incompatible composition; report whether phase fraction is identifiable and check mass balance where it is.

variables_units.M_ref,M_var: ng for arbitrary total volume 1 uL

assumptions: Synthetic values are algebraic unit tests, not empirical values for E04 or B.
Closed two-phase system, conserved masses, fixed endpoint concentrations, total volume 1 uL.
Equal selectivity means K_var=C_var,d/C_var,l equals K_ref=C_ref,d/C_ref,l while each species may differ across phases.
model_spec.range_conditions: Case A: ref d/l=10/1 and var d/l=20/2 (both K=10); test r=2 and r=1. Case B: identical endpoint concentration within each species across phases (ref 10/10, var 2/2); test r=0.2. Case C: equal-K case with r=2 where numerator and denominator vanish, plus a chosen r yielding nonzero numerator and zero denominator. Return analytic status and, for any identified phi, reconstruct both masses; do not infer empirical support.
